courses.summary: 以大型銅礦由露天向地下延伸的工程邏輯，比較物料、提升及通風邊界。 五組案例問題依序建立控制體、重算數值、檢查量測與診斷失效；計算參數是公開原理下的合成教學基準，並非該礦實際產能、設計條件或操作設定。
courses.summaryEn: Use the engineering logic of a major copper mine extending from open pit to underground to compare material, hoisting and ventilation boundaries. Five case investigations define boundaries, recalculate quantities, check measurements and diagnose failures. Numerical inputs are synthetic teaching benchmarks based on public principles, not the mine’s actual capacity, design conditions or operating settings.
